reviews.text: I never played Minesweeper as a kid because it didn´t appeal to me, but this version is impressive. The colors, items, and sounds are so engaging i can´t stop playing. Great job - you should be proud

Not gonna lie for anyone who grew up with having minesweeper on their old PC. This is a Gem. I Randomly stumpled upon this on next fest. And quickly got addicted.. not soon after i joined the Discord and the devs are really close with their players. So Communication is top tier. Today i got my hands on the full version and gotta say, the wait was totally worth it. Game is even more addicting now because there is no limit to anything anymore and so many items to build your deck with. There might be games that have been trying a smiliar approach but this is as clean as it can get and it doesnt cost half a fortune like many others do. Like i said a real gem.
Takes around 2 hours to reach the 1m. Then there's still plenty of upgrades to unlock to climb the leaderboard. If you like Minesweeper, it's worth the money.
Basically as addictive as cocaine.. but cheaper. 10/10.
"Let me just have a look into this fun little indie game before going to sleep" -Spends the whole night hunting for a higher score.

I was really looking forward to this game after playing the demo and was surprised to see how cheap it was when it finally dropped. Great game for a great price, better than other minesweeper games I've tried recently.

midas has his touch. fafnir has his hoard. sisyphus has his life. and I have my mines. never before have I known the sin of greed to such deplorable levels. I scantly remember the times before the sweeps. oh, it seems so far away now. how foolish I was, to exist without knowing the agony of the accursed 50/50s. my muscles ache. my desk accumulates monster cans. my mouse screams for new batteries. and yet. just one more click. this will not be the mine, despite me knowing full well that it is not guaranteed. and alas, like the architects of Babel, I see myself falling down towards the ground, my work collapsing around me. my own greed has brought about my downfall as that accursed red screen brings a sense of dread. that image haunts me. knowing that, if i had just decided to cash out, i would have been more successful. and yet, I continue on. god cannot scramble my languages, for I have no comrades to join me in my quest for sublimity. dionysus cannot curse me with the golden touch, as gold is what I seek. death itself cannot stop me. for there are still coins to sweep. 9.8 gumballs out of 10
It's 100% as advertised. A fun roguelike take on Minesweeper that will hook you with the sudden urge to play one more run and try to climb the leaderboard. Also, it's a steal at this price!

Already played the demo which was super fun, now its released and its more fun ! Graphics are cute, Gameplay is fun and engaging you just want to keep playing to get a good run for a good highscore ! for that price its a steal worth every cent
It's minesweeper with fun extras, and you finally have a meaningful way of dealing with 50/50s. A+ if you like minesweeper or logic puzzle games in general

It’s Minesweeper, but roguelike/deckbuilder. I absolutely love these "take a classic game and turn it into something new" indie games, and Coinsweeper is no exception. Absolutely wonderful trade-off between pling pling ploing dopamine rewards and rage-inducing explosions, as any Minesweeper game should be.
Used to play to Demo and it's getting hella addictive once you figure out how to play it. It's like a buffed version of Minesweeper with cool items. Very creative idea.
Very nice game i love it so much to play. It´s so addicting. Awesome work :)

Dead simple game that sticks some modern Balatro-esque features on top of an old classic. I have a love/hate relationship with Minesweeper, but losing a game of it sucks a lot less now. PS: I've won this game in a raffle on the Rambling Reviews Discord, you should totally give them a follow.

This is a very light recommend, especially considering the price. The core concept is easy to grasp and fairly addicting, but there is no endgame content after hitting 1 mil for the first time outside of additional modes (speedrun, no items, 2x mines) that feel unbalanced. Can't speak much about the aesthetics other than I shut off the sound within five minutes because it did not match the vibe. Great if you like chasing after high scores, but loses it's luster pretty fast.
i got it minutes after release if i remember correctly, awesome game. i found it on an old flash game website and i do not regret it

It's extremely repetitive. The equipments remind a lot about Balatro but this game is not Balatro. This game is just grinding. The achievement list is ridiculous and just a filler due to lack of imagination. Dying a certain number of times should not be an achievement (the opposite!). And if I can get a total of 1 million coins over lifetime, I bet I can also get 2 million, 5 million, 10 million, or any number of millions as well.
SOLID
An outstanding roguelite puzzler twist on Minesweeper. Great unlocks and progression. Lots of item game strategy that adds variety to every run. Definitely worth more than the asking prices. GGWP!
Basic concept that is well executed, addictive, and a ton of fun! Tried the demo during a next fest and got absolutely hooked!

This game would hit a highschool gaming website like cocaine in the 80's. the core mechanics are addictive, and is overall a great take to shake up minesweeper as a game, however the abilities do need some work. the game would be much more engaging long-term with more complex or diverse abilities, possibly with synergy. in short, it can very much be improved upon but the core gameplay has too much potential to warrant a negative review.
I love all these "new take on a classic game" games and Coinsweeper is no exception. Has me really invested (and sometimes raging, just a little) in getting to that 1 million. Some day...
